scope: Editor persistence acceptance for Meshopt: a real Host imported the upstream KHR_meshopt_compression GLB (SHA 15de7046) and environment through programmatic/resources/import, compiled the real three scene through programmatic/build/compile on the freshly installed toolchain (run-3Hn5Nw), applied a graphic clip referencing the compiled source to a project, then closed the Host and reopened it. Project snapshot (project/clips/tracks) deep-equal after reopen; project.json bytes byte-identical; the imported Meshopt GLB resource survived the reopen and re-reads with its exact sha256. The persisted build identity pins engine three, engineVersion, toolchainLock sha256 0c84ed51, compiled document id and 4 embedded resources. Browser WebGL decode, install-state and Node consumer closures are archived separately.
